mapper.sql: st.spot_idx, st.spot_id, st.name, st.region, st.address, st.latitude, st.longitude, st.description, st.spot_active, /* SPOT_REVIEW 실시간 평균 평점 */ COALESCE(( SELECT ROUND(AVG(sr.rating), 1) FROM SPOT_REVIEW sr WHERE sr.spot_idx = st.spot_idx AND COALESCE(sr.review_block, 0) = 0 ), 0.0) AS rating_avg_real, /* SPOT_REVIEW 실시간 리뷰 수 */ ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SPOT_REVIEW sr WHERE sr.spot_idx = st.spot_idx AND COALESCE(sr.review_block, 0) = 0 ) AS review_count_real, /* SPOT_LIKE 실시간 좋아요 수 */ ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SPOT_LIKE sl WHERE sl.spot_idx = st.spot_idx ) AS like_count_real, /* 대표 이미지 */ ( SELECT si.image_url FROM SPOT_IMAGE si WHERE si.spot_idx = st.spot_idx ORDER BY si.image_idx ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumb_url, /* 태그 (콤마 구분) */ ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tl.tag_name ORDER BY tl.tag_name SEPARATOR ',') FROM SPOT_TAG s_tag JOIN SPOT_TAG_LIST tl ON tl.tag_idx = s_tag.tag_idx WHERE s_tag.spot_idx = st.spot_idx ) AS tags_concat

SELECT st.spot_idx AS spotIdx, st.name AS name, st.region AS region, st.address AS address FROM SPOT_TRAVEL st WHERE COALESCE(st.spot_active, 0) = 0 AND ( st.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR st.region LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR st.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY /* 이름이 정확히 일치하는 것을 최우선으로, 그 다음 이름에 포함된 것 우선 */ CASE WHEN st.name = #{keyword} THEN 0 WHEN st.name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN st.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, st.name ASC LIMIT 7

SELECT sr.review_idx, sr.review_id, sr.user_idx, sr.spot_idx, sr.rating, sr.content, sr.created_at, sr.review_block, u.nickname FROM SPOT_REVIEW sr JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = sr.user_idx WHERE sr.spot_idx = #{spotIdx} AND COALESCE(sr.review_block, 0) = 0 ORDER BY sr.created_at DESC
